name: Arthur Lindgren
original_name: アーサー＝リンドグレン
source:
A man with the impression of a calm English gentleman.
A noble that lives close to Mother Goose's mansion.
He seems to be friends with Mother Goose and often comes to visit.
He owns the bar that [url=/c34014]Bacchus[/url] works at.
